sentences.en: They never penetrated beyond the periphery of the group.
sentences.zh: 他们从未深入到那个群体的核心。

sentences.en: Vienna lies not in the centre of Austria, but at the country's periphery.
sentences.zh: 维也纳并不位于奥地利的中心，而是在国家的边缘地带。

sentences.en: At the coastal periphery of my university, UBC, is the nudist Wreck Beach.
sentences.zh: 在我所在的英属哥伦比亚大学附近沿海区域有一个裸体海滩——废船海滩。
